dialogues.speaker: Café Lutece Message Board
dialogues.text: This is the message board of Café Lutece. Whether it be your gossip and chit-chat, your deep epiphanies, or perhaps suggestions and feedback for our café, all are welcome to leave a message here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Half the people here are lazy loafers, idling the day away and talking utter nonsense. Completely worthless."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "We're not loafers! This is libel! If you fail to offer a satisfactory apology immediately, then I shall go to the Maison Gestion and apply to duel you!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Sorry: I sincerely apologize for what I said before, after all, half the people in the café are not idle layabouts."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Can it be said that death is the only thing that is truly fair?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I do not think so. Fairness should be interpreted as a set of principles or objective standards. But death is merely a phenomenon, and not a standard, so it cannot be said to be fair."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Reply
dialogues.text: "Our shop welcomes all philosophical discussions except those about 'death.' Sorry for any inconvenience and thank you for your understanding."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The topic of 'death' is admittedly grim, and considered inauspicious, but it is ultimately an unavoidable topic that we all must face."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Reply
dialogues.text: "Our shop does not welcome any unavoidable philosophical discussions. Thank you for your understanding."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Take a look at this new law: 'All acrobatic troupes must stay away from the area of the Palais Mermonia.' What could the reasoning possibly be?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Lady Furina prances to and fro playing, but poor little artists can't even put on their performances. What a joke."

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I don't think Lady Furina has ever breathed fire in front of the Palais Mermonia, resulting in the fire suppression mechanisms being activated and damaging a large number of files."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Why not go out and walk around a bit more? Even if just to read The Steambird or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The Sumeru Akademiya has just published a new paper with the latest research. Experiments show that over 80% of those who drink iced Dandelion Wine for long periods will show symptoms of loss of liver function."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Over 70% of those who drink iced Fonta over long periods will show symptoms of loss of kidney function. Please, everyone, pay attention to your health!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Who knew that adding ice was so harmful? In the future, I certainly won't add any ice!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The topic of the lecture at Salon Caritat this week will be 'How does water pollution harm the biota of Fontaine?' Everyone is welcome to participate!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Marine pollution is already a pressing emergency, and we need everyone to contribute their strength! Save the waters of Fontaine! Save the Bathysmal Vishap!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Since when does Fontaine have Bathysmal Vishaps? You idiot."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The energy system used by Fontaine is threatening to murder our future!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "For future generations, for our descendants, we must refuse to work, refuse the trials, and oppose Indemnitium!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Monsieur Gontharet, you still haven't paid for your coffee tab last month. I hope you will settle the bill at your earliest convenience."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I heard there's been another disappearance, and it's the same modus operandi as the 'The serial disappearances of young women' case."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Didn't they already get the guy? The murderer was the former head of the Spina di Rosula, Callas the Unfaithful, wasn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I don't think it's that simple, I think there's a conspiracy at work here. Maybe there's no disappearances at all, and it's all an act."

dialogues.speaker: Maison Gardiennage
dialogues.text: "With regards to the 'The serial disappearances of young women' case, please defer to official announcements, and do not engage in baseless speculation or spread groundless rumors. The Maison Gardiennage reserves the right to use whatever means necessary to arrest the spread of rumors."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I discovered that there's a Melusine who sits there every day, sighing. Has she run into some kind of trouble?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Are you talking about Menthe? She's always saying something like 'The Iudex is above' or whatever, she must have run into some kind of intractable problem."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Menthe works for the Maison Gardiennage. She can only have become so depressed because of encountering so much unfathomable darkness in the course of her work. I truly feel sorry for her."

dialogues.speaker: Question
dialogues.text: "I have a question for everyone. I'm visiting Fontaine with my kid, and I don't know where he heard about the Oceanids, but he's throwing a tantrum about seeing them."

dialogues.speaker: Question
dialogues.text: "But the Oceanids disappeared from Fontaine long ago. As a father, should I tell him the truth, or keep making up excuses?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Just keep lying. Kids get obsessed easily but get over it quickly, he'll forget about it soon. Just play with him, and by the time he gets bored, it'll all be over."

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I think you should tell him the truth sooner rather than later. Lies cannot stay with him for his whole life, and rather than being laughed at by others later, his illusions should be gently popped by his father."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Maybe it's not important what you tell him. What's important is that you're here with him, and that you love him."

dialogues.speaker: Childishly Written Message
dialogues.text: "Though I told Daddy I wanted to come to Fontaine to see the Oceanids, my teacher said they all left Fontaine a long time ago..."

dialogues.speaker: Childishly Written Message
dialogues.text: "I just didn't want Daddy to be working all the time, and to use his vacation to spend some time with me. Though I feel a little bit guilty seeing him take looking for the Oceanids so seriously, hehe..."

dialogues.speaker: Childishly Written Message
dialogues.text: "People of Fontaine of all ages, please tell me, should I tell him the truth, or keep hiding it from him?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "My immediate superior wants me to approve the contractor's proposals for clearing out the ruins of the Fontaine Research Institute and reconstructing the Callas Line to ensure the project isn't delayed."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But the Maison Gestion leadership wants me to take my time reviewing the proposals carefully. Who should I listen to?"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Why not just have them ask the omnipotent 'Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale'? After all, it decides all matters of right and wrong here in Fontaine."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I think the articles in The Steambird are getting more boring by the day. It's all just reprinting the same hackneyed tripe that everyone already knows."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Other than Charlotte, their reporters are just fixated on superficial drivel. Sometimes their new content is nothing but hearsay, without even an iota of truth to it!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Why not give La Gouttiere a read? They've got a new editor, and the content is getting more and more riveting. It's far more interesting than some of the supposedly more truthful papers."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Personally, I think artistic trends in today's Fontaine should progress in a more realistic direction, and let the beauty and homeliness that we see with our own two eyes bloom upon the canvas."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The beauty and homeliness we see with our own two eyes? Are you from the Kamera Club?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "How dare you!? I am not! I am a painter! A painter!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "A Kamera is but a cold, unfeeling machine! The pictures it takes cannot be called art! True art requires thinking and soul!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Hey, I haven't seen Mr. Sawleg around the café lately."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You mean old Horler? Heard he got arrested. Apparently someone who was copying his performance art impersonated him on the Vasari Passage's message board."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "He was so mad, he pretended to be the Maison Gardiennage and warned them off. Though they caught the copycat, he was sentenced as well for impersonating the Maison Gardiennage."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looks like performance art in Fontaine is no path to success."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Maybe being 'judged' is part of the artwork itself."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Old friend, you are as masterful at brewing coffee as ever."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Your ability to praise others is as lousy as ever."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "With a mouth like yours, no wonder the Palais Mermonia fired you."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Then you should be thanking this mouth of mine, else you'd have no coffee to drink now."

dialogues.speaker: Incredibly Messy Handwriting
dialogues.text: "I am Samil, a visiting researcher here for an exchange with the Fontaine Research Institute. I seem to have missed the one responsible for picking me up. Does anyone know which department I should contact in such situations?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "How did you manage to get all the way over here? I've been looking all over for you! Come back to this café tomorrow — I'll meet you here then."

dialogues.speaker: Forged Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Oh, right, I forgot to mention, ask for 'Mr. Horler' when you get here."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Samil, that 'Horler' is a liar and a scammer! Don't fall for his tricks!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "You're too late, 'Horler' has already taken them to the Fleuve Cendre. Tried to convince that blasted bookworm not to go, but nothing worked. All we can do now is hope for the best."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Shocking news! Shocking news! I just saw the Chief Justice and the young boss of Spina di Rosula coming over together!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Did the cafe's owner run their mouth again and offend both the Palais Mermonia and Spina di Rosula...

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: Nonsense! If that were true, he would be sleeping with the fishes by now! The Chief Justice is here to conduct an investigation about a threatening letter written to a certain Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: A threatening letter to a Melusine!? How dare they! What idiot would look down on us Fontainians like this!?

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: Exactly! I think we shouldn't be waiting around for the Maison Gardiennage to resolve things! Let's patrol the streets to keep that Melusine safe!

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: Well said! Count me in! I live close to the horlogerie, so leave that area to me!

dialogues.speaker: Maison Cardinalice
dialogues.text: The suspect who may have sent the Melusine that threatening letter has been arrested and is undergoing strict interrogation and investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Maison Cardinalice
dialogues.text: The victim is in good health, emotionally stable, and has returned to work. Fellow citizens, we thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Maison Cardinalice
dialogues.text: On behalf of the Chief Justice, the Maison Cardinalice would like to express our gratitude to all the kind citizens who provided information and protected said Melusine during this incident.
